datasets.name: Source dataset (Hokkaido, Japan landslide)
datasets.verbatim: The source dataset was acquired by the SPOT 6 satellite... The pre- and post-event images of earthquake-triggered landslides that occurred in Hokkaido, Japan, on September 6th, 2018, were generated by fusing panchromatic and multispectral images

datasets.name: Global very-high-resolution landslide mapping (GVLM) dataset
datasets.verbatim: Experiments on a global very-high-resolution landslide mapping (GVLM) dataset consisting of 17 heterogeneous domains from different landslide sites demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of PG-DPRL... This dataset has the following properties... which will be released at https://github.com/zxk688/.

methods.name: Prototype-guided domain-aware progressive representation learning (PG-DPRL)
methods.summary: PG-DPRL is a multitarget domain adaptation (MTDA) framework for cross-domain landslide mapping. It uses a near-to-far adaptation strategy to align target domains with the source domain, employs cross-domain prototype learning to generate pseudo-labels, and uses a prototype-guided adversarial learning (PGAL) algorithm with Wasserstein distance and cross-domain prototype consistency (CPC) loss to improve representation discriminability.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is linked via the authors' GitHub repository. No repository or persistent link is provided for the custom PG-DPRL code.
